B1_pilot_slice.registration_table_discrepancy: EXPERIMENTS.md SS7.1's printed slice table is not reproducible from results/pilot_metr_v1_0.json (grok_4 T=162/E1 0.0132/rho 0.643 there vs T=97/E1 0.19701/rho 0.24486 in the artefact). The census anchors on the artefact (SS9.4).

B1.provenance_note: Census corpus = flagship-workspace copies of runs_v1_0.jsonl + runs_v1_1.jsonl (hashes in files[]), NOT the vanished code/ingest.py data tree behind the SS7.1 count of 57,936. Post-dedup census records: see n_records_after_filter_dedup.

B2.fail_reason: data presence cannot be verified at the artefact: huggingface.co/datasets/agentevals/hal_traces returns HTTP 401 (dataset page, file tree, and file resolve all probed 2026-11-01); the frozen outcome-bearing files (encrypted .zip archives, 0.3-3.5 GB each per the flagship's frozen listing) can neither be enumerated nor parsed, and SS11.1 forbids downloads of that size in any case.

B5.fail_reason: corpus verified present and MIT-licensed at github.com/earino/identical-runs-different-results (468 per-run eval.json artefacts, 36 pairings x 13 seeds), but it fails the SS5.1 selection legs: (b) the outcome is a continuous holdout AUC with no pre-stated binary bar, so binarisation would require a judgement call; and estimability: the corpus contains exactly ONE task (task/airline), so the task-sampling component E1 and the falsifier ratio E4 have no task population to estimate over.

B6.fail_reason: same HAL access failure as B2 (HTTP 401 on the agentevals/hal_traces dataset at census time): CORE-Bench's repeat structure, frozen as 're-verified at census' (PACKET_INTAKE S3.11), cannot be re-verified at the artefact; the benchmark therefore cannot pass SS5.1 ingest verification in this census.
